verdict.rationale: Consensus offers pre-run controls for depth and scope: a distinct 'Deep Search' mode for more comprehensive literature reviews, and filters to narrow by study type, year, journal, open-access status, and discipline. However, there is no evidence of adjusting effort or scope mid-execution (steering 'while it runs'), and no explicit 'effort' dial beyond choosing search vs. deep-search modes. Missing for 10: in-flight/mid-run steering controls, an explicit effort/compute slider, and independent confirmation of these controls' granularity.
